CLEAR ABOUT YOUR DATA

A small demo.
A clear data story.

This front-end website uses illustrative data and browser-local preferences. It is not a live school transport system.

What this preview does

LittleRoute demonstrates routes, fees, safety information and a parent dashboard. Names, schools, journeys and fees are sample data. The map is a schematic simulation, and payments do not transfer money.

What stays in your browser

Your display theme, layout direction, selected sample child, absence entries, alert read status and sample fee payment records may be stored using localStorage. A demo session flag uses sessionStorage. No login password is stored. If you submit the newsletter form, your email and saved date stay on this device until you clear them. The form does not connect to an email delivery service.

Forms and downloads

The contact form creates a text file on your device. It does not send an email, submit an enquiry to a server or create a booking. Estimates and sample receipts also download locally. Avoid entering real child identifiers, medical details or payment credentials.

Before a real service launches

A production service would need verified operator information, appropriate authentication and access controls, a clear privacy notice, consent and retention arrangements, secure live transport data, a real payment provider and tested communication channels. None are represented as connected in this preview.
